name: the giant in Gath
summary: A giant of the Philistines whose sons fought against Israel in David's day. Four men born to him in Gath fell by the hand of David and his servants.

key_moments.title: Abishai Saves David
key_moments.description: Ishbi-benob, one of the giant's sons, carried a heavy brass spear and meant to kill David, who had grown weary in battle. Abishai came to help David and killed the Philistine.

key_moments.title: Six Fingers and Six Toes
key_moments.description: Another son of the giant fell at Gob. At Gath a man of great size with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot defied Israel, and David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
